001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import gnu.trove.map.hash.TIntIntHashMap;
004import java.util.Arrays;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.IIntDeltaMonitor;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012import org.chocosolver.util.procedure.IntProcedure;
013
014/**
015 *
016 * @author jimmy
017 */
018public class PropElement extends Propagator<IntVar> {
019
020    private final IntVar value;
021    private final IntVar[] array;
022    private final IIntDeltaMonitor[] arrayD;
023    private final IntVar index;
024    private final int offset;
025    // Maps from an index in the array to an integer in value.
026    private final TIntIntHashMap arraySupports;
027    // Maps from an integer in value to an index in array.
028    private final TIntIntHashMap valueSupports;
029
030    public PropElement(IntVar value, IntVar[] array, IntVar index, int offset) {
031        super(buildArray(value, array, index), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, true);
032        this.value = value;
033        this.array = array;
034        this.arrayD = PropUtil.monitorDeltas(array, this);
035        this.index = index;
036        this.offset = offset;
037
038        this.arraySupports = new TIntIntHashMap(array.length);
039        this.valueSupports = new TIntIntHashMap(value.getDomainSize());
040    }
041
042    private static IntVar[] buildArray(IntVar value, IntVar[] array, IntVar index) {
043        IntVar[] variables = new IntVar[array.length + 2];
044        variables[0] = value;
045        variables[1] = index;
046        System.arraycopy(array, 0, variables, 2, array.length);
047        return variables;
048    }
049
050    private boolean isValueVar(int idx) {
051        return idx == 0;
052    }
053
054    private boolean isIndexVar(int idx) {
055        return idx == 1;
056    }
057
058    private boolean isArrayVar(int idx) {
059        return idx >= 2;
060    }
061
062    private int getArrayVarIndex(int idx) {
063        return idx - 2;
064    }
065
066    @Override
067    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
068        return IntEventType.all();
069    }
070
071    private boolean supportForArray(int index) {
072        int support = arraySupports.get(index);
073        if (value.contains(support) && array[index].contains(support)) {
074            return true;
075        }
076        int i = PropUtil.getDomIntersectDom(value, array[index]);
077        if (i == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
078            return false;
079        }
080        arraySupports.put(index, i);
081        return true;
082    }
083
084    private boolean supportForValue(int value) {
085        int support = valueSupports.get(value);
086        if (index.contains(support - offset) && array[support].contains(value)) {
087            return true;
088        }
089        int ub = index.getUB();
090        for (int i = index.getLB(); i <= ub; i = index.nextValue(i)) {
091            if (array[i + offset].contains(value)) {
092                valueSupports.put(value, i + offset);
093                return true;
094            }
095        }
096        return false;
097    }
098
099    @Override
100    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
101        index.updateLowerBound(-offset, this);
102        index.updateUpperBound(array.length - offset - 1, this);
103
104        int ub = index.getUB();
105        for (int i = index.getLB(); i <= ub; i = index.nextValue(i)) {
106            if (!supportForArray(i + offset)) {
107                index.removeValue(i, this);
108            }
109        }
110        ub = value.getUB();
111        for (int i = value.getLB(); i <= ub; i = value.nextValue(i)) {
112            if (!supportForValue(i)) {
113                value.removeValue(i, this);
114            }
115        }
116        if (index.isInstantiated()) {
117            PropUtil.domSubsetDom(array[index.getValue() + offset], value, this);
118            if (value.isInstantiated()) {
119                setPassive();
120            }
121        }
122        PropUtil.startMonitoring(arrayD);
123    }
124
125    @Override
126    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
127        if (isValueVar(idxVarInProp)) {
128            int ub = index.getUB();
129            for (int i = index.getLB(); i <= ub; i = index.nextValue(i)) {
130                if (!supportForArray(i + offset)) {
131                    index.removeValue(i, this);
132                }
133            }
134        } else if (isIndexVar(idxVarInProp)) {
135            int ub = value.getUB();
136            for (int i = value.getLB(); i <= ub; i = value.nextValue(i)) {
137                if (!supportForValue(i)) {
138                    value.removeValue(i, this);
139                }
140            }
141        } else {
142            assert isArrayVar(idxVarInProp);
143            int i = getArrayVarIndex(idxVarInProp);
144            if (index.contains(i - offset)) {
145                if (!supportForArray(i)) {
146                    index.removeValue(i - offset, this);
147                }
148                arrayD[i].forEachRemVal((IntProcedure) rem -> {
149                    if (!supportForValue(rem)) {
150                        value.removeValue(rem, this);
151                    }
152                });
153            }
154        }
155        if (index.isInstantiated()) {
156            PropUtil.domSubsetDom(array[index.getValue() + offset], value, this);
157            if (value.isInstantiated()) {
158                setPassive();
159            }
160        }
161    }
162
163    @Override
164    public ESat isEntailed() {
165        int ub = index.getUB();
166        for (int i = index.getLB(); i <= ub; i = index.nextValue(i)) {
167            int j = i + offset;
168            if (j >= 0 && j < array.length && PropUtil.isDomIntersectDom(value, array[j])) {
169                return index.isInstantiated() && value.isInstantiated() && array[j].isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
170            }
171        }
172        return ESat.FALSE;
173    }
174
175    @Override
176    public String toString() {
177        return "Element {" + Arrays.toString(array) + "}[" + index + " + " + offset + "] = " + value;
178    }
179}
